name: Grimm no Majo
source:
Lithuanis had one mission: expansion.
This was of concern to the small province of Grimm, where the Otherkin lived.
Humans and Otherkin promised long ago they would never rule each other.
Yet now, after centuries of independence, the growing empire threatened to engulf them.
Humans could leave or take the Otherkin, but Lithuanis wasn't going to let a tiny province
get in the way of manifest destiny.
If Grimm must conquered, so be it. However, that was easier said than done.
Failing peaceful annexation, Lithuanis sent mercenaries with unsavory pasts to invade.

This is the record of that invasion: the Taking of Grimm, a visual novel of plunder.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ152160.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
